title: 反垄断否决合并：精神航空的最后一根稻草
speaker: George Ferguson

segments.en: Yeah, it was uncompetitive issues. And really, we saw both carriers as being too small to affect the whole market.
segments.zh: 是反竞争问题。我们认为两家航司规模太小，不足以影响整个市场。

segments.en: There probably needs to be some consolidation or could have been some consolidation in the US airline market. Again, I think we're seeing it now.
segments.zh: 美国航空市场可能需要整合，现在也正在发生。

segments.en: Fares have been under pressure a bit with the spike in fuel. It's going to be even more challenging. I think even more capacity has to come out of the marketplace.
segments.zh: 燃料飙升使票价承压，挑战更大，市场需要进一步去产能。

segments.en: But it was struck out for anti-competitive reasons which we really couldn't understand. There's neither one of them seem to be large enough to really affect the US domestic business.
segments.zh: 但以反竞争为由被否决，我们难以理解，因为两家航司规模都不足以影响美国国内市场。
